description: This file defines the class ADOdbLoadBalancer which manages database load balancing, read/write splitting, and connection pooling for a PHP project. It also defines the supporting class ADOdbLoadBalancerConnection for individual database connections. The classes include methods for adding/removing connections, executing SQL across clusters, managing session variables, and load balancing logic.

classes.name: ADOdbLoadBalancer
classes.description: A class that manages multiple database connections for load balancing, read/write splitting, and session management.

classes.name: ADOdbLoadBalancerConnection
classes.description: A class representing a single database connection with configuration details and test callback functionality.

methods.name: setSessionInitSQL
methods.description: Defines SQL queries that are executed each time a new database connection is established.

methods.name: addConnection
methods.description: Adds a new database connection to the pool, tracking its type and weight.

methods.name: removeConnection
methods.description: Removes a database connection from the pool.

methods.name: getConnectionByWeight
methods.description: Selects a connection based on weights for load balancing.

methods.name: getLoadBalancedConnection
methods.description: Returns a connection ID considering sticky sessions and load balancing logic.

methods.name: getConnectionById
methods.description: Returns the actual ADODB connection object given a connection ID, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides a load-balanced connection, supporting pinning within transactions.

methods.name: setSessionVariable
methods.description: Sets a session variable to be maintained across connections, optionally executing immediately.

methods.name: executeSessionVariables
methods.description: Applies the stored session variables to a specific connection or cluster.

methods.name: clusterExecute
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement across all connections in the cluster.

methods.name: isReadOnlyQuery
methods.description: Determines if a given SQL query is read-only based on its syntax.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, automatically selecting read or write connection based on type.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to proxy method calls to the correct ADODB connection object, handling read/write logic.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Proxy property getter to access properties of the current ADODB connection.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Proxy property setter to set properties across all connections.
